question: HR-386: you picked moving the observability job out of the release family. Which family receives it?

options.label: maintain ⭐ (Recommended)
options.consequence: Gains the What-this-improves ladder; keeps the product rollout section; loses the release-unit section on every kind and the evidence section on product.

options.label: build
options.consequence: Gains the ladder; keeps the product evidence section; loses the rollout section and the release-unit section.
